tokens.title: Flag missing coverage by empty search results
tokens.content: If a repo_search in the test folder returns an empty matches list, treat that as a signal that the target code is not exercised. This simple check is reliable for small projects with direct naming.

tokens.title: Read source snippet before searching
tokens.content: Use repo_read to fetch the relevant lines of a file first. Seeing the exact export signature helps craft precise search queries and avoid false positives.

tokens.title: Detect untested exported functions via search
tokens.content: Run a repo_search for the export name in the source, then run another repo_search restricted to the test directory. If the second search returns no matches, the export is likely untested. This works because the search tool quickly scans all files for a string.
